verdict.rationale: The changelog documents importing collections from OpenAPI, with tags mapped to folders, and simultaneous imports of collections and environments. cURL import exists but works per request rather than per collection. That covers the import half of moving between tools. Missing for 10: any evidence of exporting collections to portable formats, import from other tools' collection formats (e.g. Postman/Insomnia), in-depth import/export docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
